title: Halloween — Five Weekly Challenges
summary: Complete all five weekly challenges to earn an extra GTA$2,000,000
description: A different challenge each week. Complete every week during October 1–November 4. The extra GTA$2,000,000 is deposited within 72 hours of completing all five; Payphone Hits is a separate bonus and does not count towards this series.
